title: Applicable law and forum
description: State / ADR / traditional-jurisdiction recourse layer. Identifies the body of law governing the order and, optionally, the named adjudication venue and proceedings language. Provider-agnostic by construction (free-form strings). Compose with `figaro-arbitration-kleros-v1` (or another `figaro-arbitration-<provider>-v1`) to add a decentralized ODR layer.

fields.name: applicableLaw
fields.description: Identifier for the body of law that governs the contract. Conventionally an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'NL', 'JP'), optionally with ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON'). 'EU' for European Union law. 'INTL' for international/treaty law. Free-form for non-state legal orders (e.g., 'Sharia', 'ICANN-UDRP').

fields.name: forum
fields.description: Named adjudication venue (e.g., 'JAMS-arbitration', 'AAA-arbitration', 'ICC-arbitration', 'us-federal-court', 'small-claims-court'). Empty means: courts of competent jurisdiction within applicableLaw.

fields.name: language
fields.description: ISO 639-1 / 639-2 language code for adjudication proceedings (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'zh', 'ar'). Empty means: official language of the forum.
